title: R's Structure
body:
# R's Structure 
## NOTE:This is a discontented project no further updates will be added
This mod adds 5 new structure(Oak house, oak abandoned house, oak library, well, Tree house) to minecraft mainly for plains biome.
All the structur's are designed and added in minecraft by me. Also reccomended to use for modpacks.
P.S:

If you want to use locate command use /locate structure rsstructure:<the structure you want to visit>
